messages:
Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — NordicRetail reached out about expanding to an in-store assistant + real-time order summarization. Noticed a sharp token/req spike yesterday. Need coordination on onboarding + capacity. @Sam (AE) can you lead renewal + commercial talk? :eyes:
Sam (AE): On it. Do we have expected team counts / concurrency? I don't want surprises with SLAs.
Ellie (CSE): Two new teams are onboarded this sprint: Stores and Ops. Rough estimate: peak concurrency ~120 req/s, avg prompt+response ~2k tokens. They plan ~3 regional replicas.
Raj (Support Eng): Filed ticket #4532 — customers reporting p95 latency ~600ms after model switch. Repro snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd/retail-v1","input":"summary"}'
```
DeployBot: Autoscale event: scaled nordic-retail-prod -> 4 workers at 2026-02-10T08:34:12Z
Maria (CS): Action items: 1) schedule tech sync with Eng-Infra + Product; 2) propose Dedicated/reserved options + cost delta; 3) prep runbook for failover. @Raj please dump perf logs to shared drive. :spiral_note_pad: 
Sam (AE): I'll book renewal call for next Tue and propose a 3-month Dedicated pilot tied to adoption metrics.
Ellie (CSE): I'll prepare onboarding checklist + two eval prompt sets (summarization, intent) and baseline quality metrics (ROUGE/precision-ish). Will flag hallucination cases.
Raj (Support Eng): Logs and dashboard uploaded: https://console.redwood.ai/d/nordic-retail/perf?from=now-1d&to=now — added notes in ticket #4532.
Maria (CS): Great. One more ask — who owns the 6-month token forecast / cost model? @Sam? Need it for procurement.
Sam (AE): Assigned to me, will deliver a token-level forecast & cost estimate by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
